'''Holtz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he approved an operation against the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]].<ref name="TOR" />
